case_store.write_policy: raw observations are immutable evidence; numbered actual trades are summarized in canonical_cases and indexed by case_registry
case_store.case_numbering_policy: news events, screenshots, regime changes and audits do not increment CASE-N; only a distinct actual position after prior closure/reset does

short_side_policy.principle: Short the failed repair or confirmed bearish leverage expansion, not the liquidation low.
required_checks: price response efficiency versus OI rebuild

edge_research_policy.primary_feature_family: price recovery efficiency relative to CVD and OI repair

youtube_teacher.input_contract: one public youtube.com or youtu.be URL

recommended_runtime_sequence: Load case_registry and canonical case summaries before raw event evidence.
Attach a new screenshot/event to the currently open canonical case unless a distinct new actual position starts after explicit closure/reset.
If the owner supplies a trading YouTube URL, invoke tools/youtube_trader_ingest_auto.py automatically.
Fetch YouTube captions automatically; if absent, attempt configured local ASR; if ASR is unavailable, continue with visual parsing and mark speech missing.
Use the local multimodal model to extract factual observations with unreadable values as UNKNOWN/null.
Load the previous compatible Snapshot from the same source/instrument series.
Evaluate BOTH long-reclaim and short-failed-reclaim paths; do not reduce bearish states to only no-long.
After capitulation, calculate whether CVD/OI recovery is producing proportional price repair.
Retrieve matching scenario trees, audit lessons and edge hypotheses.
Store each new raw observation as immutable evidence and update the open canonical case summary separately.
Do not place an order without a separate explicit execution authorization layer.
